Submitted (redline re-validated `ok:true`, minimality clean).

**Final position — T4C, deviation, preferred level, one operation on §13.2:**

> 13.2 Termination by Ono without Cause. Ono shall have the right to terminate this Agreement **for convenience at any time**, for any reasons by giving **thirty (30) days'** advance written notice to Array which shall be accompanied by the rationale for such termination, **and Array shall refund to Ono on a pro rata basis any fees prepaid by Ono for the period after the effective date of such termination.**

- Elements 1–3 addressed by that single edit; element 4 (**no Vendor convenience right**) already_met — Array's only exits are §13.3 breach, §13.4 bankruptcy and §8.2 Competing Product breach, and §13.5 confers Safety/Efficacy termination on Ono alone.
- The residual verifier note is a lexical detector artefact only: the operative text now says "for convenience" expressly, so the clause body carries the checklist wording even though the heading remains "Termination by Ono without Cause" (kept verbatim for minimality).
- §8.2's earlier-biting Competing Product tail is quarantined for a separate finding; §6.1 is uncontradicted because the refund reaches only period-allocated prepayments.

No further tool calls.
